description: This file defines a frontend API wrapper for interacting with backend analytics endpoints, including functions to fetch poll summaries and send user presence heartbeats.

methods.name: getPollSummary({ since, until, pollType })
methods.description: Fetches analytics summary data within specified time range and optional poll type.

methods.name: sendHeartbeat({ user_id, session_id, device_info, platform })
methods.description: Posts a heartbeat to the backend to track user presence.

ctags.name: getPollSummary
ctags.pattern: /^export async function getPollSummary({ since, until, pollType }) {$/

ctags.pattern: /^export async function sendHeartbeat({ user_id, session_id, device_info, platform }) {$/
